metadata.description: Australian Average Household Starter Template. All values represent national medians or averages for a dual-income couple aged 45/43 with one dependent. Load via the 'Load Data' menu, run a simulation to see a typical outcome, then replace values with your own details.
metadata.note: This is a starter template only. It does not constitute financial advice. Replace all values with your own financial details and consult a licensed financial adviser before making any decisions.

dataSources.salary: ABS Employee Earnings Aug 2025 — median full-time persons $1,741/wk ($90,532/yr)
dataSources.super: APRA Quarterly Superannuation Statistics Dec 2025 — average balance by age band
dataSources.homeValue: CoreLogic National Home Value Index Apr 2026 — national median ~$770k
dataSources.mortgageBalance: Estimated: typical 65% LVR after ~10 years of ownership on $770k home
dataSources.mortgageRate: RBA Lenders Interest Rates Apr 2026 — average variable owner-occupier rate ~6.05%
dataSources.monthlyRepayment: Calculated: P&I on $500k at 6.05% over 20 remaining years
dataSources.investmentPropertyRate: RBA — average variable investor rate Apr 2026 ~6.35%
dataSources.weeklyRent: CoreLogic gross yield 3.7% on $720k / 52 weeks ~$512; rounded to $520
dataSources.propertyGrowth: CoreLogic — 10-year capital city annualised growth average ~5.5%
dataSources.inflation: RBA target band midpoint; ABS CPI Mar 2026 = 2.4%; using 2.5%
dataSources.investmentReturn: APRA MySuper balanced 10-yr net median ~8.5%; using 7.5% as conservative blended portfolio rate
dataSources.superReturn: APRA MySuper balanced 10-yr net median ~8.5%; using 8.0% as slightly conservative
dataSources.salaryGrowth: ABS Wage Price Index Mar 2026 = 3.4% nominal; real after 2.5% inflation ~0.9%; using 1.5% for moderate optimism
dataSources.healthcareCosts: AIHW Health Expenditure Australia 2023-24 — avg out-of-pocket $1,300 + PHI single cover ~$2,300
dataSources.healthcareInflation: AIHW / ABS Health Group CPI long-run average ~5.5% pa
dataSources.agedCareProbability: AIHW 2023 — lifetime probability of entering residential aged care: 65%
dataSources.agedCareStartAge: AIHW 2023 — median age at first entry to residential aged care: 82.8 years
dataSources.agedCareDuration: AIHW 2023 — average length of stay in residential aged care: 3.5 years; using 4 years conservatively
dataSources.agedCareCost: Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission 2024-25 — average annual residential aged care cost ~$75k-$80k; using $78k
dataSources.retirementAge: ABS Retirement and Retirement Intentions Survey 2022-23 — average actual retirement age 64.3; rounding to 65
dataSources.lifeExpectancy: ABS Life Tables 2021-23 — male 81.2 yrs, female 85.3 yrs; adding 5-6 year planning buffer for longevity risk
dataSources.assetAllocation: 110 minus age (45) = 65% equities for main user; standard balanced allocation
dataSources.agePension: Services Australia March 2026 indexation — couple homeowner rates
dataSources.creditCardRate: RBA Personal Lending Rates Apr 2026 — avg credit card purchase rate ~19.95%
dataSources.personalLoanRate: RBA Personal Lending Rates Apr 2026 — avg personal loan rate ~11.99%
dataSources.carLoanRate: Major bank advertised secured car loan rates Apr 2026 — avg ~7.99%
